description: How much of the Claude Pro/Max 5-hour and weekly usage limits is used, as Claude Code itself last reported it, with when each window resets. Also the average pace within the window and the time it would reach 100% at that pace (a projection, labelled as one), and the tokens and API-equivalent cost of this machine's Claude Code turns since the window began. The percentages are recorded only while `ai-usage statusline` is configured as the Claude Code status line; without it they are reported as unavailable, never as 0%. Answers "how close am I to my limit" and "will I run out before it resets".

includeSubagents.description: Count subagent turns in this machine's token figures. Defaults to true. Does not affect the percentages, which are Claude Code's own.
